name: io.github.kevin2003050666-coder/x402-micro-tollgate
title: x402 Micro Tollgate
description: x402 HTTP 402 + MCP paywall: charge USDC per agent call. Self-host via npx or Docker.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP API key ID for the x402 facilitator

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP API key secret for the x402 facilitator

environmentVariables.name: X402_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: EVM address that receives USDC settlements

environmentVariables.name: UPSTREAM_URL
environmentVariables.description: Upstream HTTP API to proxy after payment (omit for built-in mock)

environmentVariables.name: PRICE
environmentVariables.description: Dollar price per paid call, e.g. $0.001

environmentVariables.name: NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: CAIP-2 network id (eip155:84532 Base Sepolia or eip155:8453 Base)
